materialBulk.batchHint: Move into an existing batch. Duplicate entries for the same material are blocked and will not be merged.
materialBulk.deleteWarning: These materials and all their purchase entries, image records, tag links and stock adjustment records will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Batches, distributors and image import source records will be retained.
materialBulk.deleteBlocked: These materials are referenced by DIY production records. The entire deletion is blocked.
materialBulk.changed: Data changed or the submission result could not be confirmed. Refresh and review the data before submitting again.
materialBulk.failed: The operation could not be completed. Check the reasons below.
materialBulk.formInvalid: Complete every enabled change and check stock quantities and prices for each unit.

issues.NOT_FOUND: Material no longer exists. Select again.
issues.DIY_IN_USE: Referenced by DIY production records; deletion is blocked.
issues.ENTRIES_REQUIRED: Select at least one target batch entry.
issues.TAG_NOT_FOUND: A selected tag no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
issues.BATCH_CONFLICT: The move would create duplicate entries for a material. Change the targets or destination batch.
issues.QUANTITY_REQUIRED: Enter a valid quantity for this unit.
issues.UNKNOWN_STOCK: Unknown stock can only be set to a quantity, not increased or decreased.
issues.STOCK_OUT_OF_RANGE: Resulting stock is negative, above the limit or has invalid precision.
issues.PRICE_REQUIRED: Enter at least one price for this unit.
issues.PRICE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Calculated sale price exceeds the valid amount range.
